# QR generator

`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution from
`qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license
in `qrcode-generator.LICENSE`. The npm archive was checked against its
published SHA-512 integrity value. The package's `gitHead` is
`83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/2.0.4

The browser loads this local dependency only when a visitor requests a QR code.
